porcelain-0.$description: Pure white. Light-theme cards, sheets and protected panels.

porcelain-50.$description: Warm porcelain. The light-theme page ground.

porcelain-100.$description: Light grouped-list ground and input fill; also the dark-theme text colour.

porcelain-300.$description: Light pressed fill on neutral surfaces; photo placeholder.

stone-400.$description: Disabled text and icons in light (exempt from contrast).

stone-500.$description: Light input and control borders (3:1 on surfaces).

stone-700.$description: Reserved: strong neutral text on tinted grounds.

violet-100.$description: Pale lavender: selected chips, offer and credit panels in light.

violet-200.$description: Lavender text on dark tinted panels; light pressed tint.

violet-300.$description: Dark-theme pressed primary and focus ring.

violet-400.$description: Nano violet, tone-lifted for the dark theme (primary fill, links).

violet-500.$description: Mid violet for decorative marks only; never text.

violet-600.$description: Nano violet. The primary action colour in light.

violet-700.$description: Pressed primary in light; text on lavender panels.

violet-900.$description: Dark-theme lavender panel (selected chip, offer, credit).

plum-800.$description: Logo plum, taken from the master logo file. Brand panels and editorial headlines.

night-850.$description: Dark-theme raised sheets and input fill.

mist-500.$description: Dark-theme control borders (3:1 on dark surfaces).

brick-700.$description: Danger text/icon and destructive fill, light.

surface.$description: Cards, list groups and protected opaque panels (price, booking, wallet, consent). The default container.

surface-muted.$description: Grouped-list ground, input fill, quiet secondary panels.

surface-raised.$description: Sheets, dialogs, menus: anything that floats above the page (pairs with shadow-overlay).

surface-brand.$description: Brand panels: guest hero band, app-icon ground, splash. Always carries on-brand text.

surface-tint.$description: Lavender panels: selected chips, offer cards, clinic-credit and member-status panels.

surface-pressed.$description: Pressed state of neutral rows and cards.

line.$description: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

line-strong.$description: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders: 3:1 on surface, surface-muted and bg in both themes.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-muted and surface-raised.

ink-display.$description: Editorial serif headlines on bg and surface.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, helper text and placeholders on bg, surface and surface-muted.

ink-disabled.$description: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast; never for information).

on-brand.$description: Text and the logo on surface-brand.

primary.$description: Nano violet: the one primary action per screen, selected tab, links, selected slot. As text: on bg, surface, surface-muted.

on-primary.$description: Label and icon on a primary fill. Never hard-code white: the dark theme uses dark ink.

on-tint.$description: Text and icons on surface-tint (selected chip label, credit panel figures).

focus.$description: Keyboard/switch-access focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring).

success.$description: Confirmed states (booking confirmed, payment received, published). Text/icon on bg, surface, success-soft. Always paired with an icon and word.

warning.$description: Needs attention: expiring value, slot hold running out, pending review. Text/icon on bg, surface, warning-soft.

danger.$description: Errors, declined payment, destructive actions. Text/icon on bg, surface, danger-soft; also the destructive button fill.

on-danger.$description: Label on a danger fill (destructive button).

info.$description: Neutral information, offline notices, provider hand-off notes. Text/icon on bg, surface, info-soft.

staff.$description: Staff workspace header band: marks every staff screen so it is never mistaken for the customer app.

on-staff.$description: Text and icons on the staff band.

space-1.$description: Icon-to-label gap in chips; tight stacks.

space-2.$description: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; label-to-field gap.

space-3.$description: Between related rows and chips; compact card padding.

space-6.$description: Sheet padding; hero padding; between a heading and its content.

space-10.$description: Before a screen-ending primary action block.

space-12.$description: Top of guest hero; empty-state vertical rhythm.

radius-sm.$description: Time slots, small tiles, OTP cells.

radius-xl.$description: Sheet top corners, hero panel, app icon concept (iOS masks its own).

touch-min.$description: Minimum hit area of every interactive element (44pt iOS floor, 48dp Android).

control-sm.$description: Small button and chip visual height (hit area still touch-min).

control-md.$description: Default button, input and segmented control height.

icon-sm.$description: Inline icons in captions and badges.

icon-md.$description: Icons in buttons, rows and fields.

icon-lg.$description: Tab bar and top bar icons.

tabbar-height.$description: Tab bar height above the home indicator / gesture inset.

content-max.$description: Max readable column on large phones and tablets in compatibility mode.

duration-state.$description: Chip, icon and inline status changes.

duration-overlay.$description: Custom sheet/dialog only where the native one is unavailable.

duration-navigation.$description: Reference only: the native navigator owns route transitions.

duration-reduced.$description: Max opacity fade under Reduce Motion; no translation.

ease-exit.$description: Exits: accelerate away and release focus quickly.

display-lg.$description: Guest Home hero and splash only. One per screen.

display-md.$description: Large screen titles (iOS large-title position), campaign headline.

title-lg.$description: Service and package detail titles, sheet titles.

accent-italic.$description: A single italic phrase that softens a headline. Sparingly.

headline.$description: Card and row titles, dialog titles.

body-lg.$description: Reading text: service descriptions, preparation and aftercare.

body.$description: Default UI text, list-row body, helper text.

label.$description: Chips, tabs, field labels, small buttons.

caption.$description: Metadata, timestamps, legal footnotes. Never below 13px.

overline.$description: Uppercase eyebrow above a card or section. Two or three words.

amount.$description: Totals and balances (tabular figures). Prices in rows use headline or body with tabular figures.
